generated.script: Warning: A massive credential-stealing campaign just hit GitHub! Cybersecurity researchers found malicious GitHub Actions workflows planted in thousands of repositories. Attackers compromised two major open-source maintainer accounts, pushing malicious code into over 340 projects. This included popular ones like the Pyxel game engine, impacting 27 of its repositories. These workflows are designed to steal your valuable credentials. Secure your projects: review your GitHub Actions workflows and rotate your tokens immediately.

slides.headlineRest: Credential-Stealing Workflows Planted in Tens of Thousands of Repositories
slides.body: Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered an ongoing credential-theft campaign targeting open-source projects. Attackers compromised two high-profile maintainer accounts, subsequently pushing malicious GitHub Actions workflows into over 340 repositories. One notable victim includes the 18,400-star game engine pyxel, where the attacker used its author's account to plant malicious workflows in 27 repositories. This campaign poses a significant threat, aiming to steal credentials from affected systems.
